statement: Following our work, several interesting problems deserve to be studied in future. For example, different from radius approximation, the current research on covering approximation of MEB is still inadequate. In particular, can we provide a lower bound for the complexity of computing covering approximate MEB, as the lower bound result for radius approximate MEB proved by [25]? Also, is it possible to extend the stability notion to other geometric optimization problems with more complicated structures (like subspace fitting and clustering [36], and regression problems [67])?
